1: ## 1. Shared slot taxonomy

17: ## 2. Manifest validator
18: 
19: - [x] 2.1 In `packages/dashboard-plugin-runtime/src/manifest-validator.ts`, recognise `claim.slot === "shell-overlay-route"`.
20: - [x] 2.2 Require `claim.component: string` (non-empty) for `shell-overlay-route` claims.
21: - [x] 2.3 Require `claim.config.path: string` starting with `/`. Reject missing or non-rooted paths with `ManifestValidationError`.
22: - [x] 2.4 Accept optional `claim.config.sessionParam: string`; default to `"sid"` in the normalised output.
23: - [x] 2.5 Forbid duplicate `config.path` values within a single plugin's claims.
24: - [x] 2.6 Add validator unit tests in `packages/dashboard-plugin-runtime/src/__tests__/manifest-validator.test.ts` covering: well-formed claim accepted, missing path rejected, non-rooted path rejected, duplicate paths rejected, default `sessionParam` applied.

26: ## 3. Runtime — `<ShellOverlayRouteSlot>` + hooks
27: 
28: - [x] 3.1 Create `packages/dashboard-plugin-runtime/src/shell-sessions-context.tsx` exporting `ShellSessionsContext`, `ShellSessionsProvider`, and `useShellSession(sessionId): DashboardSession | undefined`. Strict-hook contract: throw if used outside the provider.
29: - [x] 3.2 In `packages/dashboard-plugin-runtime/src/slot-consumers.tsx`, add `<ShellOverlayRouteSlot>`:
30:   - Pulls all `shell-overlay-route` claims from the registry.
31:   - For each claim, calls `useRoute(claim.config.path)`.
32:   - Renders the first match's component with `{ params, session: useShellSession(params[sessionParam]), onBack, pluginContext }`.
33:   - Renders `null` when no claim matches.
34: - [x] 3.3 In the same file, add `useShellOverlayRouteMatched(): boolean` that walks every `shell-overlay-route` claim and returns true if any matches the current URL.
35: - [x] 3.4 Re-export `ShellOverlayRouteSlot`, `useShellOverlayRouteMatched`, `ShellSessionsProvider`, and `useShellSession` from `packages/dashboard-plugin-runtime/src/index.ts`.
36: - [x] 3.5 Add `withShellSessionsProvider(sessions: Map<string, DashboardSession>, children)` test helper in `packages/dashboard-plugin-runtime/src/test-support/`.
37: - [x] 3.6 Unit tests: `ShellOverlayRouteSlot` first-match-wins; `useShellOverlayRouteMatched` aggregation; `useShellSession` returns expected DashboardSession; `useShellSession` throws outside provider.

Delete the ported arms from the shell test file.

66: ## 6. Subagents plugin — popout claim

68: - [x] 6.1 Create `packages/subagents-plugin/src/client/SubagentPopoutClaim.tsx`:

70:   - On mount, calls `pluginContext.send({ type: "subscribe", sessionId: params.sessionId, lastSeq: 0 })` exactly once (use `useRef` to guard).
71:   - Reads subagent state via `useSubagentsSessionState(params.sessionId)`.
72:   - Renders the existing `SubagentPopoutPage` body with `{ sessionId, agentId, session: { subagents }, subscriptionResolved: <state.subagents.size > 0 || <subscribe-ack received>>, parentLabel: session?.cwd, onBack }`.
73:   - Re-evaluate `subscriptionResolved` derivation — see design Decision 5; the claim can simply render "Loading parent session…" when `subagents.size === 0` AND `session === undefined`.
74: - [x] 6.2 Export `SubagentPopoutClaim` from `packages/subagents-plugin/src/client/index.tsx`.
